kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنفقئ (form VII)
# أَنْفَقِئُ (ʔanfaqiʔu) /ʔan.fa.qi.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْفَقَأَ (infaqaʔa)
# أَنْفَقِئَ (ʔanfaqiʔa) /ʔan.fa.qi.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَقَأَ (infaqaʔa)
# أَنْفَقِئْ (ʔanfaqiʔ) /ʔan.fa.qiʔ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْفَقَأَ (infaqaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
